summary: Deprecated first-generation named app-wide variable node; superseded by Variable2 and Set Variable.
description: The original read/write node for the named app-wide variable store, with an explicit `store` (Set) signal to commit its `value` input. It is superseded by Variable2 (shown as 'Variable' in the picker), which writes whenever its value input receives data, together with Set Variable for explicit signal-driven writes with type control. Both read and write the same underlying store as this node.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use Variable2 to read and write a named variable, and Set Variable for explicit signal-driven writes.
